_comment: Tier-2 for febio::hyperelasticity#2. Under DYNAMIC, a neo-Hookean cube with <density> OMITTED gives results BIT-IDENTICAL to <density>1.0</density> — which is how the silent default is established rather than assumed — while <density>1000.0</density> differs by a large relative margin and <density>0.0</density> reproduces the STATIC answer bit for bit. All five runs reach normal termination with exit 0 and no warning, so nothing in the log distinguishes them. The bit-identity assertions are what make this fixture informative; a mere "it differs" check would pass on noise. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'density_default=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
